title: A Kitchen for the Postcard Anew
author: Lena Nakamura
blurb: Coral Joubert, a ghostwriter secretly penning a rival's memoirs, believes second chances are for people with better timing. But when the anonymous pen-pal assignment pairs enemies instead of strangers, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces before the last ferry of the season departs.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
